Server environment variables

Integrations connect only when these are set on the host (Render / Railway / Docker). Keys are read by the server only — they are never stored in this app or in the repo.

VariableUsed for
DATABASE_URLPostgreSQL connection string
JWT_SECRETSigning login tokens
LIVEKIT_URLLiveKit Cloud project URL (wss://…)
LIVEKIT_API_KEYLiveKit API key — minting room tokens
LIVEKIT_API_SECRETLiveKit API secret — signing tokens
DEEPGRAM_API_KEYSpeech-to-text and Deepgram Aura text-to-speech
GROQ_API_KEYLLM — voice replies, call analysis and knowledge answers
OPENAI_API_KEYOptional — only used when LLM_PROVIDER=openai

Compliance & Launch Readiness

Guidance only — not legal advice. Confirm requirements with your legal advisor and telecom provider before launching in India.

TRAI / DLT registration (India)

  1. Register your business (Principal Entity) on your operator's DLT portal.
  2. Register headers (sender IDs) and message/call templates as required.
  3. Keep DLT registration details with your telephony provider before placing commercial calls.
  4. Respect calling-hour and consent rules for promotional communication.

Consent & Do Not Contact

SalesPilot enforces Do Not Contact: leads flagged DNC are blocked from starting a call — the server returns a 403 and the detail is shown verbatim in Live Voice Testing. Keep consent records (the Consent flag on each lead) up to date and honour opt-outs immediately.

Call recording & AI disclosure

Disclose at the start of a call that the caller is an AI agent and that the call may be recorded/transcribed, where applicable law requires it. Keep transcripts only as long as your retention policy allows.

DPDP basics

India's DPDP Act: collect personal data for a stated purpose, with consent; allow access/correction/erasure requests (use Organization → Data controls export/wipe); secure data and report breaches as required. This is general guidance, not legal advice.
